[Chain support] Pressure-fracture THREE End Stone into one existing Borax Dust and one existing Germanium Dust, preserving the exact native NC Rock Crusher batch. Each End Stone is a separate real ingredient slot; a counted single Create Crushing ingredient would charge one and triple the outputs. Industrial Iron Press owns the new pressure operation. The second output slot is technically labeled returned tool by the existing UI, but its displayed Germanium is a COPRODUCT, not a reusable tool. No output is hidden or discarded.

Quantum Infused Dust is an AdvancedAE material feed, not a finished quantum processor. Pressure-fracture one Shattered Singularity into one dust on the Industrial Iron Press; the native Inscriber conversion is also one-to-one. The dust feeds the retained Reaction Chamber quantum-infusion chain. Industrial Iron keeps this available before first Shadow machinery, avoiding a tooling loop. No extra rare ingot is useful in this fracture operation; input, output and tool stay unchanged. Returned for another judgment with its role and placement explained.

[Canonical reagent correction] Combine250mB each of existing Mekanism chlorine and hydrogen fluids into250mB Mekanism hydrogen chloride in the existing heated size3Steel Vat mixer. Only the unsupported TFMG hydrogen identity/source claim changed; quantities,600nominal work ticks, small bootstrap structure and output stay. Native separator/rotary chemical-to-fluid supply and first chemical hardware capability are independently audited. Size3means3Vat blocks, not3×3; no extra early infrastructure tax is added.

[Vibranium5/6] Controlled crystal growth consumes1000mB LIQUID helium and returns1000mB ordinary helium GAS after heat pickup. It does not return liquid coolant. The installed Supercooler requires1000gas→100liquid at50FE/t for200ticks: gas return supplies only100mB of the next1000mB liquid charge, leaving9000mB fresh gas plus10cooler operations. With the basic collector50gas/20ticks/50FE, the unupgraded steady supply is280000FE per batch; initial supply300000FE. These are native game volumes, not real gas-expansion or thermodynamic claims. Graphite seeds the existing crystal; heat:none is not an enforced maximum temperature.

[Vibranium6/6] Hot pressure-bond the grown Vibranium crystal with one existing Hard Carbon Dust on the Radiance Press. The carbon is the structural reinforcement, not another electrical component or arbitrary rare-metal fee. Keep one ingot per crystal, the existing heated pressure step and the approved shared hard-carbon powder source. This is the final densification step after electrical extraction, chill conditioning, acid treatment, calcium refining and crystal growth. It remains before first Shadow construction, which uses finished Vibranium.

[Unobtainium1/5] Keep the entire expensive original charge: finished Allthemodium, finished Vibranium, TWO complete Quantum Alloy Plates and1000mB Quantum Infusion. The powered field-assisted reaction now yields the real existing DIRTY Unobtainium Dust, not a ready-to-cast melt. A separate acid cleanup and carbon/helium refining stage must follow before cold growth and final pressure bonding. Four expanded solid ingredients exactly fit the native limit. This retains its rare/quantum source gate and adds actual process stages, rather than unrelated expensive machine blocks.

[Vibranium2/6] Chill and deagglomerate the already liberated porous clump, not an untouched hard metal workpiece.250mB liquid nitrogen gives one existing DIRTY Vibranium Dust and250mB nitrogen gas; contamination remains for the acid stage. Gas is not liquid coolant: the native Supercooler consumes1000gas per100liquid, so this returns only10% of next-batch feed. The existing NC nitrogen collector/Supercooler line supplies cooling; no new cold item is invented.

[Unobtainium2/5] Leach the slag-rich quantum reaction powder with1000mB sulfuric acid and500mB HF, then rinse in1000mB water. Sulfuric acid carries the bulk gangue load while fluoride attacks resistant oxide residue; water has a separate washing role. Recover one real existing clean Unobtainium Dust plus slag. Native nitric/aqua-regia routes were not imported: their separate gas-identity/bootstrap assumptions remain unqualified. No custom dirty-alloy token, wafer or waste fluid is introduced.

[Unobtainium3/5] Carbon-assisted deoxidation and degassing under1000mB helium produce90mB Unobtainium melt. Graphite removes remaining oxygen-bearing residue;500mB existing NC carbon monoxide makes that exhaust visible rather than copying Allthemodium water. Helium is an inert shielding feed, distinct from the liquid cryogen used next. Three powered graphite electrodes and superheated Fireproof infrastructure remain. The chemistry is a game abstraction for a fictional alloy, not a balanced material equation; no fake vapor or new fluid is created.

recipes.group: Exotic metallurgy / phase-aware acquisition and refining
recipes.comment: [Allthemodium1/4] Warm pressure-bond the original titanium, tungsten, Osmiridium and Refined Radiance solids into one as-reacted Allthemodium Clump on the Radiance Press. This is a solid-state reaction/compaction analogue, below bulk melting: it makes a rough bonded solid, not dust or final canonical melt. Crush the clump separately, acid-clean its powder and then reduce/consolidate. Keep the entire expensive four-solid bill. First Allthemodium remains before Quantum and does not require Shadow.

recipes.group: Exotic metallurgy / phase-aware acquisition and refining
recipes.comment: [Allthemodium3/4] Sulfuric acid strips oxide/contamination from the mechanically prepared dirty powder; water dilutes and rinses the bath. Preserve500mB sulfuric acid,1000mB rinse and1:1dirty→clean powder. The cold centrifuge no longer makes slag: this is dissolved contamination, not a furnace phase. Spent-bath chemistry is abstracted without adding a fake waste item or recoverable rare-metal coproduct.

recipes.group: Exotic metallurgy / phase-aware acquisition and refining
recipes.comment: [Allthemodium4/4] Use2000mB hydrogen to reduce the prepared Allthemodium powder and discharge1000mB water, explicitly following the requested two-to-one recipe convention. Borax handles the oxide film during hot consolidation; powered graphite electrodes are equipment. Preserve one finished ingot,1200nominal work and the27-block superheated Fireproof plant. This is the pack recipe convention, not an argument from native mod fluid ratios.

recipes.group: Exotic metallurgy / phase-aware acquisition and refining
recipes.comment: [Vibranium1/7] Leach the surrounding gangue/oxide film from rare Raw Vibranium in500mB hydrochloric acid diluted with500mB water, exposing one existing Vibranium Clump. The metal is left as a solid concentrate: no ordinary crusher, nitrate-to-metal magic, hydrogen bonus or tool harder than Vibranium is used. The clump still needs cryogenic fracture and subsequent powder cleanup. Cold dissolved waste is abstracted; this bath does not make slag.

recipes.group: Exotic metallurgy / phase-aware acquisition and refining
recipes.comment: [Vibranium4/7] Clean the milled, abrasive-bearing dirty powder with the existing HF-led bath:2000mB HF,250mB sulfuric carrier and1000mB water rinse. Acid attacks the resistant contamination left by comminution; the water alone is not the cleaner. Preserve one clean dust. Remove the cold solid slag output; spent dissolved bath/tailings are abstracted rather than inventing a waste item or fluid.

recipes.group: Exotic metallurgy / phase-aware acquisition and refining
recipes.comment: [Vibranium5/7] Keep the near-approved calcium/fluorite/helium refining bill: clean Vibranium Dust, one calcium ingot, one real Fluorite Gem and500mB inert helium. Calcium scavenges oxygen; fluorite fluxes the impurity phase. Three powered graphite electrodes in the27-block superheated Fireproof Vat yield90mB Vibranium melt plus90mB actual molten slag. Only the slag phase is corrected; the liked hot-refining design is preserved.
